subject: CPPO coordination: CloudBridge reseller private offer setup
messages:
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwoodinference.com>
To: Kyle Pearson <kyle.pearson@aws-partner.com>, Allyson Kim <ally@cloudbridge.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Feb 2026 16:12:00 -0800
Subject: CPPO: CloudBridge reseller private offer set up

Hi Kyle / Allyson,

Following up from the partner sync last week — CloudBridge is ready to be our reseller for the US CPPO (Channel Partner Private Offer). I want to get the CPPO request in motion so CloudBridge can resell Redwood Dedicated subscriptions through the AWS Marketplace. High-level asks:

- Can AWS confirm the CPPO intake checklist and timeline?
- Which docs do you need from CloudBridge vs from Redwood?
- Any special marketplace listing requirements (SKUs, offer terms) we should bake into the SOW?

I've attached the initial reseller MOU and a draft SOW for CloudBridge to review. Allyson, please confirm CloudBridge's partner ID and tax paperwork; Kyle, please confirm any AWS-specific form or partner IDs we need to include.

Attachments: [Redwood_CPR_Reseller_MOU.pdf (PDF)], [CloudBridge_SOW_draft.docx (DOCX)]

Proposed next step: Kyle submits the CPPO request after we confirm pricing matrix and resale flow. Can we aim for CPPO submission by end of next week?

Thanks — Sergio
Sergio Alvarez
Senior Partnerships Manager | Redwood Inference
sergio.alvarez@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

--
Redwood Inference — Developer-first inference platform
From: Kyle Pearson <kyle.pearson@aws-partner.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Allyson Kim <ally@cloudbridge.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Feb 2026 10:07:00 -0800
Subject: Re: CPPO: CloudBridge reseller private offer set up

Sergio — thanks for the note and attachments. Outline below for CPPO intake and what we need from each party. Rough timeline: 3–7 business days to validate docs, then 2–3 business days to publish the private offer once approved.

What AWS needs (from Redwood):
- Completed AWS CPPO request form (attached).
- Marketplace listing metadata and SKU mapping for the offer.
- Contact info for the Redwood Marketplace admin (email that will own the listing).

What AWS needs (from CloudBridge):
- Reseller Partner ID (APN ID) and tax / W-9 equivalent.
- Signed reseller MOU or reseller agreement (if applicable).
- Confirmation of reseller margin and invoicing flow.

Notes / constraints:
- CPPO pricing must tie back to an existing AWS Marketplace offer (we can draft a new private SKU if needed).
- If there are volume discounts or first-year promotional pricing, include term length and commit details.

I attached the CPPO intake PDF for convenience. Once you return the filled form and the pricing matrix, I’ll open the CPPO ticket and include the partner details.

Private offer intake (placeholder): TSM account: 9876543210

Attachments: [aws-cppo-request-form.pdf]

Regards,
Kyle Pearson
AWS Marketplace Partner Ops
kyle.pearson@aws-partner.com
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Allyson Kim <ally@cloudbridge.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Feb 2026 15:35:00 -0800
Subject: RE: CPPO: CloudBridge reseller private offer set up

Marissa / Aditya — looping you both in to confirm pricing and approvals so Kyle can submit. Allyson has shared preliminary margin expectations. I’m proposing the following pricing bands for the CPPO submission:

- Year 1 promotional: 18% off published list for committed annual spend >= $250k
- Standard reseller discount: 12% off list with no commit
- Renewals: revert to list unless a renewal discount is agreed in the reseller SOW

Please review and confirm if Redwood can approve the promotional band for the first contract year. I attached our current pricing sheet (pricing_sheet_q1_v2.xlsx) with recommended SKUs.

Allyson — if CloudBridge can provide APN ID and W-9 here that will speed things up.

Attachments: [pricing_sheet_q1_v2.xlsx]

Thanks,
Sergio
Senior Partnerships Manager | Redwood Inference
From: Allyson Kim <ally@cloudbridge.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: CPPO: CloudBridge reseller private offer set up

Thanks Sergio — CloudBridge can move quickly. A few clarifying items from our side:

1) Minimum margin: we need a minimum reseller gross margin of 12% after AWS fees. For the Year 1 promo, 18% off list is acceptable if Redwood will guarantee a 12-month term and the customer commit is included in the SOW.
2) Invoicing: CloudBridge invoices end customers; Redwood invoices CloudBridge (net-30). We need to confirm Redwood’s ability to issue reseller invoices rather than direct customer billing via Marketplace (CloudBridge prefers marketplace-private-offer flow with partner-managed invoices).
3) Technical: we’ll need SKU-level metering info to map our billing platform.

Attached is our draft SOW with standard reseller terms. Please flag any Redwood-specific legal items.

Attachments: [CloudBridge_SOW_draft.docx]

--
Allyson Kim
Director, Channel Sales | CloudBridge Solutions
ally@cloudbridge.com | +1 (206) 555-0199
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Feb 2026 11:00:00 -0800
Subject: Re: CPPO pricing approval (internal)

Sergio / Marissa — reviewed. Conditional approvals provided below:

- Approve Year 1 promotional band: up to 18% off list for term of 12 months with minimum annual commit of $250k.
- Approve standard reseller discount: 12% off list, no commit required.
- Require legal sign-off on reseller SOW and confirmation of invoice flow before CPPO submission.
- Compliance check (Aisha) to validate CloudBridge APN ID and run AML/KYC quick screen.

I’ve uploaded an approved pricing sheet for the CPPO submission. Please have CloudBridge sign the reseller MOU via DocuSign.

Attachments: [approved_pricing_sheet.xlsx]

Aditya Rao
Head of Partnerships | Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com

Date: Mon, 23 Feb 2026 14:22:00 -0800
Subject: CPPO submitted — private offer ID PO-879122-AWS

Sergio / Allyson / Marissa — quick update: AWS has submitted the CPPO on your behalf. Private offer ID: PO-879122-AWS. Marketplace listing will be published as a private offer tied to the Redwood Dedicated SKU set once final metadata is confirmed. Estimated publish date: 2–3 business days from now pending final form validation.

What we did:
- Validated APN and reseller documentation provided by CloudBridge.
- Accepted Redwood’s approved pricing matrix and Year 1 promo terms (as submitted by Aditya).
- Uploaded CPPO intake form and created the private offer record.

Next steps:
- Allyson: confirm DocuSign execution for the reseller MOU and return signed copy to Kyle for the marketplace record.
- Sergio / Marissa: confirm the Marketplace admin email that will manage the offer listing.
- AWS: will post the private offer link and share the marketplace URL once live.

Attachments: [aws-cppo-receipt.pdf]

Private Offer link (placeholder): https://aws.amazon.com/marketplace/pp/prodview-PO-879122-AWS

Thanks — Kyle
